node.title: L1 m=4, h=3, nu=2 fixed-point certificate
node.statement: In every base-field-normalized positive (nu,deg H)=(2,1) record, Frobenius orbit parity and the product of the fixed split fiber force the normalized domain coset to equal cK and its binomial parameter to be A=c^n. Exactly one of +c,-c is the unique prime-field root of the fixed fiber and the other is a complement root. Hence every Belyi multiplicity triple satisfies one of two explicit scalar equations and a canonical scalar-free divisibility F_e^3-2F_e+1 | W^n-1. This is a necessary certificate, not a converse, exclusion, or L1 closure.
